main.title: Elden Ring
main.summary: Elden Ring is a 2022 action role-playing game directed by Hidetaka Miyazaki with worldbuilding provided by the American fantasy writer George R. R. Martin.

cards.heading: A quest through the Lands Between
cards.text: Elden Ring is a 2022 action role-playing game directed by Hidetaka Miyazaki with worldbuilding provided by the American fantasy writer George R. R. Martin. Developed by FromSoftware and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment, it was first released on February 25, 2022, for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S with a Nintendo Switch 2 version released on August 28, 2026. Set in the Lands Between, players control a customizable player character on a quest to repair the Elden Ring and become the new Elden Lord.

cards.heading: Torrent, hidden dungeons and other players
cards.text: Elden Ring is presented through a third-person perspective with players freely roaming its open world. The six main areas can be traversed using the player character's steed Torrent. Linear, hidden dungeons can be explored to find useful items. Players engage enemies using various weapons and magic spells, and can focus on non-direct engagement enabled by stealth mechanics. Throughout the game's world, checkpoints enable fast travel and allow players to improve their attributes using an in-game currency called runes. Elden Ring features an online multiplayer mode in which players join through cooperative play to fight bosses or engage in player versus player combat.

cards.heading: Martin and Miyazaki divide the storytelling work
cards.text: FromSoftware wanted to create an open-world game based on Dark Souls. Miyazaki admired Martin's previous work and hoped that his contributions would produce a more accessible narrative than those of the company's earlier games. Martin was given freedom to design the backstory, while Miyazaki acted as lead writer for the in-game narrative. The developers concentrated on environmental scale and the story; the scale required the construction of several structures around its world.

cards.heading: Success, Shadow of the Erdtree and a spinoff
cards.text: Elden Ring won several Game of the Year awards and has been cited as one of the greatest games of all time, with praise directed towards its open world, gameplay systems, and setting. It sold over 30 million copies, also making it one of the best-selling games of all time. The downloadable content (DLC) Shadow of the Erdtree follows the player character in the Land of Shadow. It was released in June 2024 to similar acclaim and sold over ten million copies. A multiplayer-focused spinoff game, Elden Ring Nightreign, was released in 2025. A film adaptation has been announced for a 2028 release.

main.title: Aperture Desk Job
main.subtitle: Steam Deck's Manual Becomes a Comedy
main.summary: Aperture Desk Job puts a new employee behind a desk in the world of Portal.

cards.heading: A first day at the wrong workplace
cards.text: Aperture Desk Job puts a new employee behind a desk in the world of Portal. Valve released the free playable short in March 2022 for the arrival of Steam Deck. An apparently ordinary first shift becomes an opportunity for the company's machinery and promises to go wrong.

cards.heading: Teach the hands through a joke
cards.text: Valve describes the short as a way to introduce the handheld's controls and features. Tasks in the scene make the player use those controls within a comic situation, rather than study a separate diagram. A hardware demonstration becomes something with a workplace, a companion and a reason to press the next button.

cards.heading: A short with a specific purpose
cards.text: Desk Job's short format introduces a device within one sitting. Its tasks, workplace and companion give the control demonstration a setting inside Aperture Science. The result connects learning the handheld's buttons to a comic sequence that can be completed before moving to another game.

main.title: Triangle Strategy
main.subtitle: A political choice becomes a battlefield
main.summary: Triangle Strategy is Square Enix and Artdink's tactical role-playing game, first released for Switch on 4 March 2022.

cards.heading: A political choice becomes a battlefield
cards.text: Triangle Strategy is Square Enix and Artdink's tactical role-playing game, first released for Switch on 4 March 2022. The struggle among Norzelia's powers places Serenoa Wolffort and his companions between political demands and the consequences of their decisions. Battles use small character figures across detailed HD-2D terrain, while conversations and investigations give the next confrontation its context. The campaign asks the player to understand both kinds of position: where a unit stands on a battlefield and where its allies stand on the choice that leads there.

cards.heading: Use the ground as part of the attack
cards.text: Height, direction and cooperation influence attacks. Placing allies on opposite sides of an opponent can trigger a follow-up strike, and approaching from above or behind increases the advantage. Terrain also supports elemental interactions: water can extend lightning, fire can hinder a route, and wind can push an enemy towards a drop. Each character has a distinct role and rechargeable Tactical Points for abilities. The player builds a plan from those relationships, treating the map as an active part of the encounter rather than a surface on which units merely wait.

cards.heading: Persuade the people who hold the vote
cards.text: At major decisions, the group consults the Scales of Conviction and votes on a course of action. Exploring and gathering information can help persuade a companion before that vote, connecting quieter scenes to the route taken by the story. Branches alter events and available allies before leading towards the campaign's endings. Akira Senju composed the score. The game gives tactical preparation a narrative counterpart: success depends on learning about the situation, understanding another character's position and making a choice whose effects continue into the next stage of the journey.

main.title: Gran Turismo 7
main.summary: Gran Turismo 7 is a 2022 sim racing video game developed by Polyphony Digital and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment.

cards.heading: A new generation for Gran Turismo
cards.text: Gran Turismo 7 is a 2022 sim racing video game developed by Polyphony Digital and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment. It is the eighth main installment and the thirteenth overall in the Gran Turismo series, following Gran Turismo Sport (2017). The game was released for the PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5. Gran Turismo 7 features virtual reality (VR) support with PlayStation VR2 through a free in-game update.

cards.heading: Critics and player protests
cards.text: Gran Turismo 7 received generally positive reviews from critics, with praise for its graphics and gameplay. However, player reception was more negative, with criticism of its use of microtransactions and focus on grinding. The game was subject to intense review bombing on Metacritic, lowering its user score.

cards.heading: The Café shapes the campaign
cards.text: Gran Turismo 7 features the return of the single player campaign, GT Simulation Mode. Other returning features are the return of traditional racing tracks and vehicles, Special Events, Championships, Driving School, Tuning Parts Shop, Used Cars dealership, and GT Auto while still retaining the new GT Sport Mode, Brand Central, and Discover (now labelled Showcase) that were introduced in Gran Turismo Sport. The player needs to progress through tasks ("Menu Books") from the GT Café to unlock features like multiplayer, and all tracks and cars.

cards.heading: Weather, online saves and offline play
cards.text: The game features the return of dynamic time and weather effects, which previously appeared in Gran Turismo 5 and Gran Turismo 6. Despite the game including a single player campaign, like with Gran Turismo Sport, the game requires a constant internet connection and a PlayStation Network account in order for players to be able to save their progress. The series creator Kazunori Yamauchi explains that this decision was made to prevent cheating. Arcade mode is fully playable offline.

cards.heading: The PlayStation 5 features
cards.text: For the PlayStation 5 version, the game takes advantage of the console's increased processing power, dedicated ray-tracing hardware, custom solid-state drive storage, Tempest Engine, and DualSense controller to support features such as advanced haptic technology feedback, adaptive triggers, real-time ray tracing effects, 3D spatial audio, and reduced loading times. The PlayStation 5 version of Gran Turismo 7 also runs at 4K resolution and 60 frames per second with support for high dynamic range, a significant improvement to performance on original PlayStation 4 consoles which run in 1080p. In addition, drivers from Gran Turismo's esports competition, the Gran Turismo World Series (previously the FIA-Certified Gran Turismo Championships utilizing Gran Turismo Sport), appear as AI opponents and License Test coaches.

cards.heading: Cars and circuits in October 2026
cards.text: As of October 2026, with version 1.72, Gran Turismo 7 features 580 cars and 42 track environments with 122 layouts.

cards.heading: Past, present and future
cards.text: In a July 2019 interview with GTPlanet, a fan website dedicated to the Gran Turismo series, Yamauchi stated that the next Gran Turismo title is in active development. Yamauchi confirmed that there would be a focus on fine tuning the classic GT experience, and added: "I think the next title that we're going to create will be a combination of the past, present and future – a complete form of Gran Turismo."

main.title: Tunic
main.summary: Tunic is a 2022 action-adventure game developed by Isometricorp Games and published by Finji.

cards.heading: A fox among ruins and manual pages
cards.text: Tunic is a 2022 action-adventure game developed by Isometricorp Games and published by Finji. It is set in a ruined fantasy world, where the player controls an anthropomorphic fox on a journey to free a fox spirit trapped in a crystal. The player discovers the gameplay and setting by exploring and finding in-game pages of a manual that offers clues, drawings, and notes. The backstory is obscured; most text is given in a constructed writing system that the player is not expected to decipher. Tunic's isometric perspective hides numerous pathways and secrets.

cards.heading: Seven years building a world of secrets
cards.text: Designer Andrew Shouldice developed Tunic, his first major game, over seven years. He began work on it as a solo project in 2015, wanting to combine challenging gameplay with gentle visual and audio design. He was inspired by his childhood experiences playing Nintendo Entertainment System games like The Legend of Zelda (1986) and trying to understand game manuals for which he lacked context. Shouldice was joined during development by composers Terence Lee and Janice Kwan, audio designer Kevin Regamey, developer Eric Billingsley, and producer Felix Kramer. Publisher Finji joined the project in 2017 and announced Tunic at E3 2017.

cards.heading: From release to recognition
cards.text: Tunic was released for macOS, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S in March 2022, followed by ports for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 in September. It received positive reviews, especially for its aesthetics, design, and gameplay, but drew some criticism for uneven difficulty and potential for players to feel stuck. Tunic won the Outstanding Achievement for an Independent Game award at the 26th Annual D.I.C.E. Awards, and the Artistic Achievement and Debut Game awards at the 19th British Academy Games Awards.

main.title: Tiny Tina's Wonderlands
main.summary: Tiny Tina's Wonderlands is a 2022 action role-playing first-person shooter video game developed by Gearbox Software and published by 2K.

cards.heading: A tabletop fantasy in the Borderlands world
cards.text: Tiny Tina's Wonderlands is a 2022 action role-playing first-person shooter video game developed by Gearbox Software and published by 2K. As a spin-off in the Borderlands series and a sequel to Tiny Tina's Assault on Dragon Keep DLC for Borderlands 2, the game is set within the world of a fantasy-themed tabletop role-playing game. The game was released for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One and Xbox Series X/S in March 2022.

cards.heading: Crossing the Overworld together
cards.text: Similar to its predecessors, the game is a first-person shooter with elements of an action role-playing game. The game can be played solo or with up to three other players in online or local split-screen multiplayer. The game is set within the world of a fantasy-themed tabletop role-playing game. The game features an overworld, which is used by the playable characters to traverse the various locations in the game. There are random combat encounters and quests that can only be completed in the overworld.

cards.heading: Custom heroes, firearms and spells
cards.text: The player creates a character rather than choosing a named Vault Hunter. Classes provide skills that can be combined, while hero points develop attributes. Guns still arrive through Borderlands' varied loot system, but a dedicated melee slot encourages closer fighting. Spells replace grenades and recharge after use: one may summon meteors, another transform an enemy into a sheep. Rings and an amulet add further bonuses to the build. The mixture lets a found weapon, class ability or new spell suggest a different approach without abandoning the series' familiar cycle of fighting and collecting equipment.
